body: U+0023# Sweep merged; repository licensed under Apache 2.0 (PRs open)U+000AU+000AU+002A*Sweep.** PR #205 (the accessibility sweep) was merged by the owner.U+000AU+002D Report: `testkit/results/android/a11y-sweep/REPORT.md`.U+000AU+002D Independent code review: `testkit/results/android/a11y-sweep/CODE-REVIEW.md`. Nothing makes a baseline line wrong. It raised 2 medium issues:U+000A  U+002D A stateful finder that matches nothing is skipped silently. The c6 photo size and side controls are never built at phone width.U+000A  U+002D A build exception during pumping is not reported as "did not load".U+000AU+002D It also raised 4 low issues: prefix-only rule tests, real-clock reads in garden and search, test-order dependence, and phone repeated-text reading `content-desc` only.U+000AU+002D All of these, plus the four blind spots in the report, go into the follow-up fix spec.U+000AU+000AU+002A*License.** The owner asked for the repository to be licensed under Apache 2.0, covering every change from the first commit, before making it public to lift the Actions limits.U+000AU+002D Branch `chore/apache-license` (commit d797a58, signed) adds:U+000A  U+002D `LICENSE`: the exact ASF text, SHA-256 cfc7749b…3d30.U+000A  U+002D `NOTICE`: the retroactive scope over every commit on every ref, naming the root commits `a77a244` (the app), `2977eb9` (`_ledger`) and `dbde1db` (`refs/logbook/ledger`), plus the third-party exceptions.U+000A  U+002D A License section in the README.U+000AU+002D PR #206 targets main and PR #207 targets `feat/composer-editor-core`.U+000AU+002D Third-party material that keeps its own license:U+000A  U+002D `third_party/camera_macos` is MIT; the owner's local changes to it are under Apache 2.0.U+000A  U+002D `assets/fonts` are OFL 1.1.U+000A  U+002D The CommonMark and GFM fixtures are CC BY-SA 4.0.U+000AU+002D Authors across all refs: only the owner, plus the "Continuity Ledger" tool identity. There are no co-authors.U+000AU+002D A history scan found no secret patterns and no keystore or `.env` files.U+000AU+002D CI on #206 failed without starting, because of the billing limit.U+000AU+000AU+002A*Goes public with the repo:**U+000AU+002D the `_ledger` branch (decisions and session logs)U+000AU+002D `refs/logbook/ledger`U+000AU+002D the `refs/mitosis/*` refsU+000AU+002D the commit email satanshumishra@outlook.com
